overview: Close the remaining settings gaps: profile editing, workspace creation, member management (invite/remove/roles), password change, 2FA setup, language selector backed by the i18n foundation, and account deletion.

scopeCuts: Focus on settings parity inside mobile settings routes, hooks/store, and account client
Exclude admin-only workspace settings, workspace avatar editing, server-side administration

prerequisites: Existing scaffold/auth/api client/settings phases are already implemented in mobile/
AccountClient supports profile update, workspace creation, member management, password change, and 2FA
Settings repository and hooks exist for profile and workspace queries
mobile-infra-parity TASK-001 (i18n foundation) must land before TASK-007
nonGoals: Admin-only workspace settings (password aging, compliance rules)
Workspace avatar editing with image cropping
Server-side workspace administration beyond AccountClient API
Custom theme colors or advanced appearance settings
contracts: Account operations use mobile/src/client/account.ts wrapping AccountClient
Profile name updates use AccountClient; avatar updates use the existing workspace/person mutation path
New settings routes stay under mobile/src/app/(app)/settings/**
Existing theme toggle, notification preferences, and logout must not regress
Member role changes validate against AccountRole enum from @hcengineering/core
Member role changes use AccountClient; member removal uses workspace membership mutation via the members repository / Huly client

tasks.title: Add profile editing (name and avatar)
tasks.description: Upgrade the read-only profile header to support editing name and uploading an avatar.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile section shows edit icons on name and avatar; tapping name opens inline editor, tapping avatar opens image picker.
Name changes are saved via AccountClient; avatar changes use the existing workspace/person mutation path, and the profile display updates immediately without requiring a screen reload.
Upload failures or invalid names show recoverable errors without clearing the existing profile data.

tasks.title: Add workspace creation flow
tasks.description: Allow users to create a new workspace from the workspace list screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Workspace list screen shows a Create Workspace button that navigates to a creation form.
Successful creation calls AccountClient's workspace creation method and switches to the new workspace.
Duplicate URL slug or validation errors show recoverable inline errors without losing form data.

tasks.title: Add member invite flow
tasks.description: Allow workspace owners/maintainers to invite new members from the members screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Members screen shows an Invite button (visible only to owners/maintainers) that opens an invite form.
Successful invite sends the invitation via AccountClient and shows a confirmation toast.
Invalid email or permission errors show recoverable errors; the invite form does not close on failure.

tasks.title: Add member remove and role change
tasks.description: Allow workspace owners to remove members and change roles from the member detail.
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping a member row opens a detail sheet with role selector and Remove action.
Role changes call AccountClient.updateWorkspaceRole(); removals call AccountClient.leaveWorkspace() with the target account, and both refresh the member list on success.
Cannot demote the last owner or remove self; both show explicit error messages.

tasks.title: Add change password screen
tasks.description: Allow users to change their password from settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings index shows a Change Password row that navigates to a form with current, new, and confirm fields.
Successful change calls AccountClient's password change method and shows confirmation; session remains active.
Wrong current password or weak new password shows field-level validation errors without clearing the form.

tasks.title: Add 2FA setup/management screen
tasks.description: Allow users to enable, verify, and disable TOTP 2FA from settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings shows a Two-Factor Authentication row with current status; tapping opens the setup/manage screen.
Enable flow shows QR code and manual secret, then verifies a TOTP code before activating; disable requires TOTP.
Invalid verification codes show inline errors; enable/disable state reflects correctly after change.

tasks.title: Add language selector
tasks.description: Allow users to select their preferred language from settings after the i18n foundation is in place.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings shows a Language row with the current language from the i18n configuration introduced by mobile-infra-parity TASK-001; tapping opens a picker with available locales.
Language selection persists to the settings store and AsyncStorage, updates the active i18n locale immediately, and restores on app restart.
Selecting a language with incomplete translations falls back to English for missing keys and surfaces a non-blocking translation incomplete note.

tasks.title: Add account deletion flow
tasks.description: Allow users to delete their account from settings with confirmation safeguards.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings shows a Delete Account row in a danger zone section; tapping opens a two-step confirmation (type workspace name to confirm).
Successful deletion calls AccountClient.deleteAccount(accountUuid) (from auth store), clears all local state, navigates to login screen.
Failed deletion (server error, network failure) shows recoverable error and does not clear local state.

failureModes.recovery: Show retry button; preserve existing avatar
Show inline error on slug field
Show explicit cannot demote last owner message
Show inline error; allow retry without restarting flow
Show warning listing affected workspaces before confirming

testCoverageMap: TASK-001: profile edit save + avatar upload failure + name validation
TASK-002: workspace creation + duplicate slug error + switch after create
TASK-003: invite form + permission gate + invalid email error
TASK-004: role change + remove member + last-owner protection
TASK-005: password change + wrong current password + weak password validation
TASK-006: QR code display + TOTP verify + enable/disable state
TASK-007: language picker + persistence + missing translation fallback
TASK-008: delete confirmation + password verification + cleanup + failure recovery
